emma (AE): Quick heads-up 1: Pinnacle Health requested a CEO-to-CEO sync tomorrow 9:00 PT. They want: firm on-prem pilot dates, KMS BYO confirmation, and a commercial anchor.
julian (CRO): can we run 20m; keep the deck to one slide + one-pager. I'll lead commercial.
omar (SE): need to confirm HSM support (PKCS11) and network keepalive needs. Also baseline throughput they expect.
sylvia (Security): i'll draft a 3-bullet security summary: data residency options, KMS integration steps (ETA 3-5w), and logging retention.
emma (AE): Pinnacle asked for a signed timeline for pilot delivery during the call. we need a gated SOW timeline.
revops-bot: auto: any discount >15% opens approval queue #RV-3191.
doc-bot: created brief https://redwood.app/briefs/pinnacle-3240001111 and invited team.
omar (SE): confirmed: our agent supports BYO-KMS (PKCS11/HSM) and streaming over websockets; fallback is 60s polling. I'll add a network checklist.
sylvia (Security): added bullets to the brief and a recommended NDA amendment line re: subprocessors.
julian (CRO): pricing anchor posted in brief: start at 14% off list with pilot credits; escalate if they request >18%.
emma (AE): action items: omar final tech bullets (ETA 2h), sylvia finalize security note (ETA 3h), julian prep talking points (ETA 2h). I'll post final one-pager 60m before call.
julian (CRO): i'll be on the bridge; escalate unresolved residency/legal asks to me and sylvia. :thumbsup:
